## Colors

```{r}

topic_colors<- c("Behavioral and Mental Health" = "#4E79A7",
  "Access to Care and Healthcare Equity" = "#F28E2B",
  "Chronic Disease Management" = "#E15759",
  "Social Determinants of Health" = "#76B7B2",
  "Healthy Behaviors and Wellness" = "#59A14F",
  "Community Safety" = "#EDC948",
  "Maternal, Infant, and Child Health" = "#B07AA1",
  "Environmental Health" = "#FF9DA7",
  "Injury Prevention and Safety" = "#9C755F",
  "Healthcare Capacity" = "#BAB0AC"
)

```


## Combine

```{r. dataset_combine}

# 1. Join data and data1 with CHNA and IPLAN labels
final_merged <- full_join(
  data,
  data1,
  by = "County",
  suffix = c("_CHNA", "_IPLAN")
)

# 2. Create Geographic Group
final_merged <- final_merged %>%
  mutate(
    Rurality = as.numeric(as.character(Rurality)),
    Geographic_Group = case_when(
      City == "Chicago" ~ "Chicago",
      County == "Cook" ~ "Suburban Cook",
      !is.na(Rurality) & Rurality >= 1 & Rurality <= 3 ~ "Urban Non-Cook",
      !is.na(Rurality) & Rurality >= 4 & Rurality <= 6 ~ "Suburban Non-Cook",
      !is.na(Rurality) & Rurality >= 7 & Rurality <= 10 ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# 3. Check column names
names(final_merged)

```

## CHNA Priorities

```{r}

# 1. Clean and summarize CHNA Priority 1 topics
chna_top_priority_clean <- final_merged %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`Priority 1_CHNA`),
    `Priority 1_CHNA` != "",
    !is.na(Geographic_Group)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = stringr::str_squish(`Priority 1_CHNA`)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Geographic_Group, Topic) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Geographic_Group) %>%
  filter(n == max(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Graph
p_chna_top <- ggplot(
  chna_top_priority_clean,
  aes(x = Geographic_Group, y = n, fill = Topic)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.65,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n >= 3, n, "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = topic_colors,
    guide = guide_legend(
      nrow = 3,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_width(10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Most Frequently Reported First-Ranked CHNA Priorities\nAcross Geographic Groups",
    subtitle = "Hospital Community Health Needs Assessments (CHNAs)",
    x = "Geographic Group",
    y = "Number of Hospitals",
    fill = "Top Health Priority"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 20)
  )

p_chna_top

```

## CHNA Leaflet

```{r, chna_plotly}


library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# 1. Geographic group order
geo_order <- c(
  "Chicago",
  "Rural",
  "Suburban Cook",
  "Suburban Non-Cook",
  "Urban Non-Cook"
)

# 2. Prepare all five CHNA priorities
chna_priority_clean <- final_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(paste0("Priority ", 1:5, "_CHNA")),
    names_to = "Priority",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Priority = str_extract(Priority, "[1-5]"),
    Topic = str_squish(Topic),
    Geographic_Group = as.character(Geographic_Group)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Topic),
    Topic != "",
    !is.na(Geographic_Group)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Priority, Geographic_Group, Topic) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Priority, Geographic_Group) %>%
  filter(n == max(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Create a fixed topic color lookup
all_topics <- unique(chna_priority_clean$Topic)

topic_palette <- setNames(
  topic_colors[all_topics],
  all_topics
)

# 4. Build interactive graph
p_chna_interactive <- plot_ly()

for (i in 1:5) {

  plot_data <- chna_priority_clean %>%
    filter(Priority == as.character(i))

  for (topic in all_topics) {

    topic_data <- plot_data %>%
      filter(Topic == topic)

    # Include all geographic groups, even when count is zero
    topic_data <- tibble(
      Geographic_Group = geo_order
    ) %>%
      left_join(
        topic_data %>%
          select(Geographic_Group, n),
        by = "Geographic_Group"
      ) %>%
      mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0))

    p_chna_interactive <- p_chna_interactive %>%
      add_trace(
        data = topic_data,
        x = ~Geographic_Group,
        y = ~n,
        type = "bar",
        name = topic,
        legendgroup = topic,
        marker = list(
          color = unname(topic_palette[topic]),
          line = list(color = "black", width = 0.3)
        ),
        width = 0.65,
        text = ~paste0(
          "Geographic Group: ", Geographic_Group,
          "<br>Health Priority: ", topic,
          "<br>Number of Hospitals: ", n
        ),
        hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
        visible = (i == 1),
        showlegend = TRUE
      )
  }
}

# 5. Number of traces per priority
traces_per_priority <- length(all_topics)

# 6. Dropdown visibility
visibility <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {
  rep(
    seq_len(5) == i,
    each = traces_per_priority
  )
})

# 7. Final layout
p_chna_interactive <- p_chna_interactive %>%
  layout(
    barmode = "stack",

    title = list(
      text = "Most Frequently Reported First-Ranked CHNA Priorities<br>Across Geographic Groups",
      x = 0.5,
      font = list(size = 11)
    ),

    xaxis = list(
      title = list(text = "Geographic Group"),
      type = "category",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = geo_order,
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = geo_order,
      ticktext = geo_order,
      tickangle = 30,
      tickfont = list(size = 8)
    ),

    yaxis = list(
      title = list(text = "Number of Hospitals"),
      dtick = 10,
      rangemode = "tozero"
    ),

    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = -0.35,
      title = list(text = "Top Health Priority"),
      font = list(size = 7),
      traceorder = "normal",
      showlegend = TRUE
    ),

    margin = list(
      l = 65,
      r = 20,
      t = 100,
      b = 170
    ),

    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        direction = "down",
        x = 1,
        xanchor = "right",
        y = 1.2,
        buttons = lapply(1:5, function(i) {
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = visibility[[i]]),
              list(
                title = paste0(
                  "Most Frequently Reported CHNA Priorities (Priority ",
                  i,
                  ")<br>Across Geographic Groups"
                )
              )
            ),
            label = paste("Priority", i)
          )
        })
      )
    )
  )

# 8. Display
p_chna_interactive


```

## IPLAN Priorities


```{r, iplan-plotly}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Geographic group order
geo_order <- c(
  "Chicago",
  "Rural",
  "Suburban Cook",
  "Suburban Non-Cook",
  "Urban Non-Cook"
)

# Prepare all five IPLAN priorities
iplan_priority_clean <- iplan_combined %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(paste0("Priority ", 1:5)),
    names_to = "Priority",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = stringr::str_squish(Topic),
    Priority = stringr::str_extract(Priority, "[1-5]")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Topic),
    Topic != "",
    !is.na(Geographic_Group)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Priority, Geographic_Group, Topic) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Priority, Geographic_Group) %>%
  filter(n == max(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get all topics and matching colors
all_topics <- names(topic_colors)
topic_palette <- topic_colors

# Check for IPLAN topics without an assigned color
setdiff(all_topics, names(topic_palette))

# Create interactive Plotly graph
p_iplan <- plot_ly()

for (i in 1:5) {

  plot_data <- iplan_priority_clean %>%
    filter(Priority == as.character(i))

  for (topic in all_topics) {

    topic_data <- tibble(
      Geographic_Group = geo_order
    ) %>%
      left_join(
        plot_data %>%
          filter(Topic == topic) %>%
          select(Geographic_Group, n),
        by = "Geographic_Group"
      ) %>%
      mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0))

    p_iplan <- p_iplan %>%
      add_trace(
        data = topic_data,
        x = ~Geographic_Group,
        y = ~n,
        type = "bar",
        name = topic,
        legendgroup = topic,
        marker = list(
          color = unname(topic_palette[topic]),
          line = list(color = "black", width = 0.3)
        ),
        width = 0.65,
        text = ~paste0(
          "Geographic Group: ", Geographic_Group,
          "<br>Health Priority: ", topic,
          "<br>Number of IPLAN Assessments: ", n
        ),
        hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
        visible = (i == 1),
        showlegend = TRUE
      )
  }
}

# Dropdown visibility
traces_per_priority <- length(all_topics)

visibility <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {
  rep(seq_len(5) == i, each = traces_per_priority)
})

# Graph formatting
p_iplan <- p_iplan %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste(
        "Most Frequently Reported IPLAN Priorities",
        "Across Geographic Groups",
        sep = "<br>"
      ),
      x = 0.5,
      font = list(size = 16)
    ),

    barmode = "stack",
    
  xaxis = list(
  title = list(text = "Geographic Group", standoff = 15),
  type = "category",
  categoryorder = "array",
  categoryarray = geo_order,
  tickmode = "array",
  tickvals = geo_order,
  ticktext = geo_order,
  tickangle = 20,
  tickfont = list(size = 10),
  showgrid = FALSE,
  automargin = TRUE
),

  yaxis = list(
      title = list(text = "Number of Hospitals", standoff = 15),
      dtick = 10,
      rangemode = "tozero"
    ),

  legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = -0.35,
      title = list(text = "Top Health Priority"),
      font = list(size = 7),
      traceorder = "normal"
    ),

margin = list(
  l = 70,
  r = 30,
  t = 110,
  b = 230
),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        direction = "down",
        x = 1,
        xanchor = "right",
        y = 1.18,
        buttons = lapply(1:5, function(i) {
          list(
            method = "update",
            args = list(
              list(visible = visibility[[i]]),
              list(
                title = list(
                  text = paste(
                    "Most Frequently Reported Priority", i,
```

## CHNA Stacked

```{r}

# 1. Calculate counts
chna_counts <- final_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority"),
    names_to = "Priority_Rank",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_squish(as.character(Topic)),
    Geographic_Group = str_squish(as.character(Geographic_Group))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Topic),
    Topic != "",
    !is.na(Geographic_Group),
    Geographic_Group != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(`Hospital ID`, Geographic_Group, Topic) %>%
  count(Topic, Geographic_Group, name = "Count")

# 2. Calculate total counts per topic
topic_totals <- chna_counts %>%
  group_by(Topic) %>%
  summarise(Total_Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Calculate percentages and order factors
chna_percent <- chna_counts %>%
  left_join(topic_totals, by = "Topic") %>%
  group_by(Topic) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = reorder(Topic, Total_Count),
    Geographic_Group = factor(
      Geographic_Group,
      levels = c(
        "Chicago",
        "Suburban Cook",
        "Suburban Non-Cook",
        "Urban Non-Cook",
        "Rural"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Geographic_Group))

# 4. Create graph
chna_stacked_plot <- ggplot(
  chna_percent,
  aes(x = Topic, y = Percentage, fill = Geographic_Group)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    width = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
     values = c(
  "Chicago" = "#6A3D9A",             # Purple
  "Suburban Cook" = "#FF7F00",       # Orange
  "Suburban Non-Cook" = "#A6CEE3",   # Light blue
  "Urban Non-Cook" = "#33A02C",      # Green
  "Rural" = "#B15928"                # Brown
    ),,
    breaks = c(
      "Chicago",
      "Suburban Cook",
      "Suburban Non-Cook",
      "Urban Non-Cook",
      "Rural"
    ),
    drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(
      reverse = TRUE,
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic Distribution of Hospital CHNA Priorities",
    subtitle = "Hospital Community Health Needs Assessments (CHNAs)",
    x = "Health Priority",
    y = "Percentage of Hospital Assessments",
    fill = "Geographic Location",
    caption = str_wrap(
      "Note: Each bar represents 100% of hospital assessments identifying that priority. Geographic sections represent the distribution across the five geographic groups. Hospitals are counted once per health priority.",
      width = 95
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = 1.1
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
legend.box = "vertical",
legend.justification = "center",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 7,
      hjust = 0,
      color = "grey35",
      lineheight = 1.2,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 20)
  )

chna_stacked_plot

```

## CHNA

```{r}

# 1. Calculate CHNA priority counts by geographic group
chna_counts <- final_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority") & ends_with("_CHNA"),
    names_to = "Priority_Rank",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_squish(as.character(Topic)),
    Geographic_Group = str_squish(as.character(Geographic_Group))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Topic), Topic != "",
    !is.na(Geographic_Group), Geographic_Group != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(`Hospital ID`, Geographic_Group, Topic) %>%
  count(Topic, Geographic_Group, name = "Count")

# 2. Identify the top three overall CHNA priorities
chna_top3 <- chna_counts %>%
  group_by(Topic) %>%
  summarise(Total_Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(Total_Count, n = 3, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  pull(Topic)

# 3. Calculate total hospitals per geographic group
chna_totals <- final_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(Geographic_Group), Geographic_Group != "") %>%
  distinct(`Hospital ID`, Geographic_Group) %>%
  count(Geographic_Group, name = "Total")

# 4. Complete geographic group combinations
chna_top3_data <- chna_counts %>%
  filter(Topic %in% chna_top3) %>%
  complete(
    Topic,
    Geographic_Group = c(
      "Chicago",
      "Suburban Cook",
      "Suburban Non-Cook",
      "Urban Non-Cook",
      "Rural"
    ),
    fill = list(Count = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(chna_totals, by = "Geographic_Group") %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = if_else(
      !is.na(Total) & Total > 0,
      Count / Total * 100,
      0
    ),
    Geographic_Group = factor(
      Geographic_Group,
      levels = c(
        "Chicago",
        "Suburban Cook",
        "Suburban Non-Cook",
```

## IPLAN

```{r}

# 1. Calculate IPLAN priority counts by geographic group
iplan_counts <- final_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority") & ends_with("_IPLAN"),
    names_to = "Priority_Rank",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_squish(as.character(Topic)),
    Geographic_Group = str_squish(as.character(Geographic_Group))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Topic), Topic != "",
    !is.na(Geographic_Group), Geographic_Group != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(County, Geographic_Group, Topic) %>%
  count(Topic, Geographic_Group, name = "Count")

# 2. Identify top three overall IPLAN priorities
iplan_top3 <- iplan_counts %>%
  group_by(Topic) %>%
  summarise(Total_Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(Total_Count, n = 3, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  pull(Topic)

# 3. Calculate total counties per geographic group
iplan_totals <- final_merged %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Geographic_Group),
    Geographic_Group != "",
    !is.na(County)
  ) %>%
  distinct(County, Geographic_Group) %>%
  count(Geographic_Group, name = "Total")

# 4. Complete geographic group combinations
iplan_top3_data <- iplan_counts %>%
  filter(Topic %in% iplan_top3) %>%
  complete(
    Topic,
    Geographic_Group = c(
      "Chicago",
      "Suburban Cook",
      "Suburban Non-Cook",
      "Urban Non-Cook",
      "Rural"
    ),
    fill = list(Count = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(iplan_totals, by = "Geographic_Group") %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = if_else(
      !is.na(Total) & Total > 0,
      Count / Total * 100,
      0
    ),
    Geographic_Group = factor(
      Geographic_Group,
      levels = c(
        "Chicago",
        "Suburban Cook",
        "Suburban Non-Cook",
        "Urban Non-Cook",
        "Rural"
      )
    )
  )

# 5. Geographic colors

  "Suburban Cook" = "#FF7F00",       # Orange
  "Suburban Non-Cook" = "#A6CEE3",   # Light blue
  "Urban Non-Cook" = "#33A02C",      # Green
  "Rural" = "#B15928"                # Brown
)

# 6. Create horizontal grouped bar graph

    y = Percentage,
    fill = Geographic_Group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    drop = FALSE,

      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +

    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of Top Three Overall IPLAN Priorities",
    subtitle = "Comparison Across Geographic Groups",
    x = "Health Priority",
    y = "Percentage of Counties",
    fill = "Geographic Group",
```

## Cook vs. Chicago

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# 1. CHNA: Count unique hospitals identifying each priority for Chicago and Suburban Cook
chna_cook_chicago <- final_merged %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group %in% c("Chicago", "Suburban Cook")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority") & ends_with("_CHNA"),
    names_to = "Priority_Rank",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_squish(as.character(Topic)),
    # Keep it as "Suburban Cook" to match your data
    Geographic_Group = recode(
      Geographic_Group,
      "Suburban Cook" = "Suburban Cook",
      "Chicago" = "Chicago"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "") %>%
  distinct(`Hospital ID`, Geographic_Group, Topic) %>%
  count(Topic, Geographic_Group, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Source = paste(Geographic_Group, "CHNA")) # Becomes "Suburban Cook CHNA" and "Chicago CHNA"

# CHNA denominators: unique hospitals in each geographic group
chna_denominators <- final_merged %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group %in% c("Chicago", "Suburban Cook")) %>%
  mutate(
    Geographic_Group = recode(
      Geographic_Group,
      "Suburban Cook" = "Suburban Cook",
      "Chicago" = "Chicago"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(`Hospital ID`, Geographic_Group) %>%
  count(Geographic_Group, name = "Total")

# Calculate percentages and order topics by total sum
chna_cook_chicago <- chna_cook_chicago %>%
  left_join(chna_denominators, by = "Geographic_Group") %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = (Count / Total) * 100,
    Percentage = replace_na(Percentage, 0),
    Topic = fct_reorder(Topic, Percentage, .fun = sum, .desc = FALSE)
  )

# 2. Polished Graph (CHNA Only: Suburban Cook vs. Chicago)
chna_cook_chicago_plot <- chna_cook_chicago %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Topic, y = Percentage, fill = Source)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(38)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 115),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Chicago CHNA" = "#7FA9B1",
    "Suburban Cook CHNA" = "#4A777A"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Hospital CHNA Health Priorities: Suburban Cook vs. Chicago",
    subtitle = "Percentage of hospitals identifying each priority",
    x = "Health Priority",
    y = "Percentage of Hospitals",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Note: Percentages represent the proportion of unique hospitals within Suburban Cook or Chicago identifying each priority."
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(t = 12)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 15)
  )
```

## Poverty and Uninsured
```{r}

library(scales)

# 1. Calculate uninsured rate
final_merged <- final_merged %>%
  mutate(
    Uninsured_Rate = (`Uninsured Population` / Population) * 100
  )


# 2. Identify top three IPLAN Priority 1 topics
top3_iplan <- final_merged %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`Priority 1_IPLAN`),
    `Priority 1_IPLAN` != ""
  ) %>%
  count(`Priority 1_IPLAN`, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  pull(`Priority 1_IPLAN`)


# 3. Categorize counties by poverty and uninsured rate
priority_social <- final_merged %>%
  mutate(
    Poverty_Group = if_else(
      `Poverty Rate` >= median(`Poverty Rate`, na.rm = TRUE),
      "Higher Poverty",
      "Lower Poverty"
    ),
    Uninsured_Group = if_else(
      Uninsured_Rate >= median(Uninsured_Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
      "Higher Uninsured",
      "Lower Uninsured"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(`Priority 1_IPLAN` %in% top3_iplan) %>%
  distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE)


# 4. Calculate percentages for poverty
poverty_percentage <- priority_social %>%
  count(`Priority 1_IPLAN`, Poverty_Group, name = "Counties") %>%
  group_by(Poverty_Group) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = Counties / sum(Counties) * 100,
    Indicator = "Poverty Rate",
    Group = Poverty_Group
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# 5. Calculate percentages for uninsured
uninsured_percentage <- priority_social %>%
  count(`Priority 1_IPLAN`, Uninsured_Group, name = "Counties") %>%
  group_by(Uninsured_Group) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = Counties / sum(Counties) * 100,
    Indicator = "Uninsured Rate",
    Group = Uninsured_Group
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# 6. Combine both datasets
priority_percentage <- bind_rows(
  poverty_percentage,
  uninsured_percentage
)


# 7. Create combined graph
priority_social_plot <- ggplot(
  priority_percentage,
  aes(
    x = `Priority 1_IPLAN`,
    y = Percentage,
    fill = Group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = "dodge",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Indicator) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Higher Poverty" = "#1F4E79",
      "Lower Poverty" = "#A6CEE3",
      "Higher Uninsured" = "#E15759",
      "Lower Uninsured" = "#F4A6A6"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
 breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    limits = c(0, 110),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  )+
  labs(
    title = "Socioeconomic Characteristics Across Top IPLAN Priorities",
    subtitle = "Percentage distribution of counties by poverty and uninsured levels",
    x = "IPLAN Priority 1",
    y = "Percentage of Counties",
    fill = "County Category"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 11, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), # Facet titles
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12), face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10), face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# 1. Deduplicate to unique counties and compute standardized rates/percentages
county_desc_data <- final_merged %>%
  distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert raw demographic counts to % of county population
    Pct_Age_0_17 = (`Age 0-17` / Population) * 100,
    Pct_Age_65_Plus = (`Age 65 and over` / Population) * 100,
    Pct_White = (White / Population) * 100,
    Pct_Black = (`Black or African American` / Population) * 100,
    Pct_Hispanic = (Hispanic / Population) * 100,
    Pct_Asian_NHPI = (`Asian, Native Hawaiian, or Pacific Islander` / Population) * 100,
    Pct_Foreign_Born = (`Forgein Born` / Population) * 100, # Adjust spelling if fixed in your df
    
    # Standardize Poverty and Uninsured metrics (Rates per 100,000 + Percentages)
    Poverty_Per_100k = (`County Poverty per Persons` / Population) * 100000,
    Poverty_Rate_Pct = `Poverty Rate` * 100, # Converts 0.12 -> 12.0%
    Uninsured_Per_100k = (`Uninsured Population` / Population) * 100000,
    Uninsured_Rate_Pct = Uninsured_Rate
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Total County Population` = Population,
    `Rurality Score (RUCC 1–9)` = Rurality,
    `Median Household Income ($)` = `Median Household Income`,
    `Poverty Rate (%)` = Poverty_Rate_Pct,
    `Poverty per 100,000` = Poverty_Per_100k,
    `Uninsured Rate (%)` = Uninsured_Rate_Pct,
    `Uninsured per 100,000` = Uninsured_Per_100k,
    `Age 0–17 (%)` = Pct_Age_0_17,
    `Age 65 and Over (%)` = Pct_Age_65_Plus,
    `White (%)` = Pct_White,
    `Black or African American (%)` = Pct_Black,
    `Hispanic or Latino (%)` = Pct_Hispanic,
    `Asian / NHPI (%)` = Pct_Asian_NHPI,
    `Foreign-Born (%)` = Pct_Foreign_Born
  )

# 2. Compute summary statistics across unique counties
summary_table_df <- county_desc_data %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(Value)),
    Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Preserve exact logical ordering
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = names(county_desc_data))) %>%
  arrange(Variable)

# 3. Format into a publication-ready table using gt
desc_stats_table <- summary_table_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Descriptive Statistics**"),
    subtitle = "Illinois County Demographic and Socioeconomic Characteristics (Unique Counties)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Mean, SD, Median, Min, Max),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = N,
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = Variable
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(N, Mean, SD, Median, Min, Max)
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Note: Statistics are calculated across unique counties represented in final_merged. Demographic subgroups, poverty, and uninsured metrics are standardized as percentages or rates per 100,000 residents."
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    table.width = pct(100)
  )
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------
# 1. IPLAN OVERLAP
# Uses the existing cook_chicago dataset
# ------------------------------------------

# Extract unique priorities for each area
ucook_iplan <- cook_chicago %>%
  filter(Area == "Suburban Cook") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique()

chicago_iplan1 <- cook_chicago %>%
  filter(Area == "Chicago") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique()

iplan_topics <- final_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(Geographic_Group), Geographic_Group != "") %>%
  select(Geographic_Group, ends_with("_IPLAN")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_IPLAN"),
    names_to = "Priority_Rank",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_remove(Topic, "_IPLAN$"),
    Topic = str_trim(Topic)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "") %>%
  distinct(Geographic_Group, Topic)

rural_iplan <- iplan_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Rural") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()

sncook_iplan <- iplan_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Suburban Non-Cook") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()

scook_iplan <- iplan_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Suburban Cook") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()


# ------------------------------------------
# 2. CHNA OVERLAP
# ------------------------------------------

chna_topics <- final_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(Geographic_Group), Geographic_Group != "") %>%
  select(Geographic_Group, ends_with("_CHNA")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_CHNA"),
    names_to = "Priority_Rank",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_remove(Topic, "_CHNA$"),
    Topic = str_trim(Topic)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "") %>%
  distinct(Geographic_Group, Topic)

# Extract priorities for each area
chicago_chna1 <- chna_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Chicago") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()

scook_chna <- chna_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Suburban Cook") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()

rural_chna <- chna_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Rural") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()

ucook_chna <- chna_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Urban Non-Cook") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()

sncook_chna <- chna_topics %>%
  filter(Geographic_Group == "Suburban Non-Cook") %>%
  pull(Topic) %>% unique()


# ------------------------------------------
# 3. GEOGRAPHIC GROUP CHNA vs IPLAN OVERLAP
# ------------------------------------------

# Organize CHNA priorities
chna_groups <- list(
  "Rural" = rural_chna,
  "Suburban Cook" = scook_chna,
  "Suburban Non-Cook" = sncook_chna,
  "Urban Non-Cook" = ucook_chna,
  "Chicago" = chicago_chna1
)

# Organize IPLAN priorities
iplan_groups <- list(
  "Rural" = rural_iplan,
  "Suburban Cook" = scook_iplan,
  "Suburban Non-Cook" = sncook_iplan,
  "Urban Non-Cook" = ucook_iplan,
  "Chicago" = chicago_iplan1
)

# Clean priorities
clean_topics <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])
}

chna_groups <- lapply(chna_groups, clean_topics)
iplan_groups <- lapply(iplan_groups, clean_topics)

# Calculate overlap between CHNA and IPLAN
calculate_cross_overlap <- function(chna_groups, iplan_groups) {

  purrr::map_dfr(names(chna_groups), function(group_name) {

    chna <- chna_groups[[group_name]]
    iplan <- iplan_groups[[group_name]]

    shared <- base::intersect(chna, iplan)
    all_unique <- unique(c(chna, iplan))

    tibble(
      Geographic_Group = group_name,
      Shared_Priorities = length(shared),
      Total_Unique_Priorities = length(all_unique),
      Overlap_Percentage = if (length(all_unique) == 0) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        round(length(shared) / length(all_unique) * 100, 1)
      }
    )
  })
}

group_overlap <- calculate_cross_overlap(
  chna_groups,
  iplan_groups
)


# ------------------------------------------
# 4. TOTAL CHNA vs IPLAN OVERLAP
# ------------------------------------------

all_chna <- unique(unlist(chna_groups))
all_iplan <- unique(unlist(iplan_groups))

shared_chna_iplan <- base::intersect(
  all_chna,
  all_iplan
)

all_unique_chna_iplan <- unique(c(
  all_chna,
  all_iplan
))

total_overlap <- tibble(
  Geographic_Group = "Total",
  Shared_Priorities = length(shared_chna_iplan),
  Total_Unique_Priorities = length(all_unique_chna_iplan),
  Overlap_Percentage = if (length(all_unique_chna_iplan) == 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    round(
      length(shared_chna_iplan) /
        length(all_unique_chna_iplan) * 100, 1
    )
  }
)

overlap_results <- bind_rows(
  group_overlap,
  total_overlap
)

overlap_results


# ------------------------------------------
# 5. DISPLAY ALL SHARED PRIORITIES
# ------------------------------------------

all_shared_priorities <- bind_rows(

  # Geographic group shared priorities
  purrr::map_dfr(names(chna_groups), function(group_name) {

    shared <- base::intersect(
      chna_groups[[group_name]],
      iplan_groups[[group_name]]
    )

    tibble(
      Geographic_Group = group_name,
      Shared_Priority = shared
    )
  }),

  # Overall shared priorities
  tibble(
    Geographic_Group = "Total",
    Shared_Priority = shared_chna_iplan
  )
)

all_shared_priorities
```
